rows.note: This is the all-purpose grammatical term for both the comparative degree and an adjective or adverb in that form.

example.english: The grammar teacher said that the comparative of the adjective “big” is “bigger.”
example.traditional: 文法老師話，形容詞「大」嘅比較級係「大啲」。
